elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code to calculate the p-value for a left-tailed hypothesis test using the normal distribution. Code imports norm from scipy.stats, defines x = -1.846, mean = 0, standard_deviation = 1, and calculates the cumulative distribution function norm.cdf(x, mean, standard_deviation) rounded to 4 decimal places. The output shown is 0.0324.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to calculate the p-value for a left-tailed hypothesis test using Python's scipy.stats.norm.cdf function.
